title: 水的三态变化
nativeSvg:
<svg data-theme="aurora" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:inkscape="http://www.inkscape.org/namespaces/inkscape" width="1600" height="1000" viewBox="0 0 1600 1000">
<title>水的三态变化</title>
<defs><linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#071423" stop-opacity="1"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#17112F" stop-opacity="1"/></linearGradient><filter id="blur" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="220%" height="220%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="70"/></filter><linearGradient id="temp" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#7FD3FF" stop-opacity="1"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFB36B" stop-opacity="1"/></linearGradient></defs>
<g id="layer1" inkscape:groupmode="layer" inkscape:label="背景">
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1600" height="1000" fill="#081521"/>
</g>
<g id="layer2" inkscape:groupmode="layer" inkscape:label="极光">
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1600" height="1000" fill="url(#bg)"/>
<ellipse cx="300" cy="120" rx="420" ry="110" fill="#2FE3A0" opacity="0.38" filter="url(#blur)"/>
<ellipse cx="900" cy="60" rx="520" ry="120" fill="#7B61FF" opacity="0.42" filter="url(#blur)"/>
<ellipse cx="1400" cy="180" rx="360" ry="130" fill="#27B5F2" opacity="0.32" filter="url(#blur)"/>
</g>
<g id="layer3" inkscape:groupmode="layer" inkscape:label="标题">
<text x="80" y="100" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="44" font-weight="600" fill="#F2F6FF">水的三态变化</text>
<text x="82" y="140" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#A9BAD6">冰、水、水蒸气之间的六种变化；橙色吸热，蓝色放热</text>
</g>
<g id="layer4" inkscape:groupmode="layer" inkscape:label="三态">
<rect x="200" y="560" width="320" height="160" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="360" y="634" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="40" font-weight="700" fill="#F2F6FF" text-anchor="middle">冰</text>
<text x="360" y="674" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="17" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">固态，有固定的形状</text>
<rect x="1080" y="560" width="320" height="160" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="1240" y="634" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="40" font-weight="700" fill="#F2F6FF" text-anchor="middle">水</text>
<text x="1240" y="674" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="17" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">液态，会流动</text>
<rect x="640" y="250" width="320" height="160" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="800" y="324" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="40" font-weight="700" fill="#F2F6FF" text-anchor="middle">水蒸气</text>
<text x="800" y="364" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="17" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">气态，看不见</text>
</g>
<g id="layer5" inkscape:groupmode="layer" inkscape:label="变化">
<line x1="530" y1="666" x2="1058" y2="666" stroke="#FFB36B" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<path d="M1070.0,666.0 L1056.3,672.1 L1056.3,659.9 Z" fill="#FFB36B"/>
<text x="800" y="712" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#FFB36B" text-anchor="middle">熔化，吸热</text>
<text x="800" y="738" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">冰雪消融</text>
<line x1="1070" y1="614" x2="542" y2="614" stroke="#7FD3FF" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<path d="M530.0,614.0 L543.7,607.9 L543.7,620.1 Z" fill="#7FD3FF"/>
<text x="800" y="568" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#7FD3FF" text-anchor="middle">凝固，放热</text>
<text x="800" y="594" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">水结成冰</text>
<line x1="1116" y1="520.83" x2="963.76" y2="413.57" stroke="#FFB36B" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<path d="M953.9,406.7 L968.7,409.6 L961.6,419.5 Z" fill="#FFB36B"/>
<text x="1061.47" y="426.14" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#FFB36B" text-anchor="middle">汽化，吸热</text>
<text x="1061.47" y="452.14" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">湿衣服晾干、水烧开</text>
<line x1="924" y1="449.17" x2="1076.24" y2="556.43" stroke="#7FD3FF" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<path d="M1086.1,563.3 L1071.3,560.4 L1078.4,550.5 Z" fill="#7FD3FF"/>
<text x="978.53" y="543.86" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#7FD3FF" text-anchor="middle">液化，放热</text>
<text x="978.53" y="569.86" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">水蒸气遇冷变成“白气”</text>
<line x1="513.95" y1="563.34" x2="666.19" y2="456.08" stroke="#FFB36B" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<path d="M676.0,449.2 L668.3,462.0 L661.3,452.1 Z" fill="#FFB36B"/>
<text x="621.47" y="543.86" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#FFB36B" text-anchor="middle">升华，吸热</text>
<text x="621.47" y="569.86" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">冰冻的衣服也能变干</text>
<line x1="646.05" y1="406.66" x2="493.81" y2="513.92" stroke="#7FD3FF" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<path d="M484.0,520.8 L491.7,508.0 L498.7,517.9 Z" fill="#7FD3FF"/>
<text x="538.53" y="426.14" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#7FD3FF" text-anchor="middle">凝华，放热</text>
<text x="538.53" y="452.14" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">霜、雾凇</text>
</g>
<g id="layer6" inkscape:groupmode="layer" inkscape:label="温度">
<rect x="200" y="880" width="1200" height="10" rx="5" fill="url(#temp)"/>
<line x1="200" y1="872" x2="200" y2="898" stroke="#F2F6FF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
<text x="200" y="924" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">-20 °C</text>
<line x1="371.43" y1="872" x2="371.43" y2="898" stroke="#F2F6FF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
<text x="371.43" y="924" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">0 °C</text>
<line x1="542.86" y1="872" x2="542.86" y2="898" stroke="#F2F6FF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
<text x="542.86" y="924" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">20 °C</text>
<line x1="714.29" y1="872" x2="714.29" y2="898" stroke="#F2F6FF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
<text x="714.29" y="924" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">40 °C</text>
<line x1="885.71" y1="872" x2="885.71" y2="898" stroke="#F2F6FF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
<text x="885.71" y="924" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">60 °C</text>
<line x1="1057.14" y1="872" x2="1057.14" y2="898" stroke="#F2F6FF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
<text x="1057.14" y="924" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">80 °C</text>
<line x1="1228.57" y1="872" x2="1228.57" y2="898" stroke="#F2F6FF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
<text x="1228.57" y="924" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">100 °C</text>
<line x1="1400" y1="872" x2="1400" y2="898" stroke="#F2F6FF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
<text x="1400" y="924" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#A9BAD6" text-anchor="middle">120 °C</text>
<text x="371.43" y="860" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#F2F6FF" text-anchor="middle">0 °C 冰开始熔化</text>
<text x="1228.57" y="860" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#F2F6FF" text-anchor="middle">100 °C 水沸腾</text>
<text x="1420" y="896" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#A9BAD6">标准大气压下</text>
</g>
</svg>
